h1: AVANI Pattaya Resort — A Green Garden Resort in Central Pattaya Next to a Mall and a Walk to the Beach
intro: Picture this: a few steps out of the lobby and you walk straight into Royal Garden Plaza shopping centre, but step back into the resort and you find a shady green garden and a pool so calm it feels like a different city — AVANI Pattaya Resort is a 5-star resort under Avani / Minor Hotels sitting right in the middle of Central Pattaya, next to a mall, a walk to Pattaya Beach, and only about an 8-minute walk from Walking Street · what most people talk about is that it's a garden oasis in the middle of one of Thailand's busiest towns — every room has a balcony, and the pool sits in the garden with a slide and swim-up bar · 300 rooms and suites, from about ฿4,000/night, scoring 9.2 from 303 reviews on Trip.com and 4.5/5 from over 2,500 reviews on TripAdvisor.

body.html: An overview of who AVANI Pattaya suits — if you want the shortest summary, AVANI Pattaya Resort is a resort for people who want a "resort feel right in the city centre" · it's not a high-rise hotel selling sea views from the 30th floor, and it's not a quiet out-of-town resort you have to drive far to reach · instead it's a low-rise resort with a green garden and pool at its centre, set on the Central Pattaya beach road, right next to Royal Garden Plaza shopping centre · the building has been open since 1978 and went through a major renovation in 2016 before coming under the Avani brand of Minor Hotels · it's still open today and performing well, with TripAdvisor ranking it among the top hotels in Pattaya (around #25 out of over 600 hotels), a score of 4.5 out of 5 from over 2,500 reviews, and Trip.com giving it 9.2 from 303 reviews · the voices from real reviews agree that the people it suits best are families with young children, couples who want a garden atmosphere but still want to walk out at night, and travellers who are tired of high-rises and would rather fall asleep to the sound of the garden than traffic · another group that says it left an impression is people who stayed years ago and came back, because they're familiar with the location and an atmosphere that's unlike anything else in Pattaya · you could say it's a resort that strikes a nice balance between "calm but convenient".

Location and getting around — this is without question AVANI Pattaya's number-one selling point · the resort sits on the Central Pattaya beach road, on the southern side of Pattaya Bay, right next to Royal Garden Plaza shopping centre, which brings restaurants, shops and a cinema together in one place, and also houses Ripley's Believe It or Not! and Louis Tussaud's wax museum in the same mall · a few steps across the road and you reach Pattaya Beach, and crucially it's only about an 8–9 minute walk from Walking Street — for anyone who wants to head out and explore Pattaya's nightlife and stroll back to bed easily, this location works really well · getting around further afield is still convenient: hop on the red songthaews that run along the beach road all over town, reach Terminal 21 Pattaya or Central Pattaya in about 5–10 min by car, and the resort is about 45 min from U-Tapao Airport (UTP) and about 1 hr 45 min to 2 hr by car from Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK) · one small note: the Central Pattaya beach road is an area that gets congested and lively in the evening, so if you call a Grab in the early evening you may need to allow extra time, and rooms facing the road at the front will pick up some sound from the entertainment district, which we'll cover in the noise section below.

"It's right in the thick of it, next to the mall, just ten minutes' walk to Walking Street, but the moment you walk into the resort it's so quiet and shady it's surprising — the pool sits in a garden of big trees, like slipping into another world. The kids played on the slide all day."

Room types and decor — AVANI Pattaya has around 300 rooms and suites in total, split across several levels and views · it starts with the Deluxe Garden Plus Room and Deluxe Sea View Room at about 38 sqm, which are larger than the standard rooms at many high-rise hotels in Pattaya · moving up there's the Garden View Corner Suite at 45 sqm, a corner room with more light and space, and the Terrace Junior Suite at 52 sqm, with a wide terrace nice for lounging · the highlight reviews agree on is that every room has a private balcony or terrace, facing the garden, pool or sea depending on the type · the decor is a warm, contemporary resort style, leaning on woodwork and earth tones, giving a relaxed feel rather than a cold, luxurious one · every room has air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, minibar, safe, tea/coffee maker and free Wi-Fi · many reviews agree that the rooms are spacious, the beds comfortable, and the balcony is a nice spot for morning coffee · to be straight with you, there are some voices saying the decor and certain details are starting to look dated with the age of the building, which has been open a long time, even though it was renovated in 2016 — it's something to set the right expectations for: this is a resort that sells a garden atmosphere and location more than brand-new, flawless rooms · if you want the best-condition room, it helps to ask for a recently renovated room or a refurbished floor when you book.

Facilities, pool and spa — the most talked-about highlight of AVANI Pattaya is the pool set in a green garden, surrounded by large shady trees, giving a private, cool feel even though it's in the middle of the city · the pool comes with a water slide, swim-up bar, poolside bar, and cabanas to sit in the shade, while the kids get a separate pool, which puts families with young children at ease · this is what clearly sets it apart from the high-rise hotels in Pattaya, because you get a real resort atmosphere rather than a narrow rooftop pool · on the wellness side there's a spa and massage rooms, plus a fitness centre open 24 hours for anyone who wants to work out or unwind after a full day out · on top of that there's poolside massage, parking, and free Wi-Fi throughout, along with meeting rooms and event space for seminar groups · to be honest, the pool isn't a long lap pool for serious exercise swimming — it's more a pool for splashing about, relaxing, and letting kids enjoy the slide, but in terms of garden atmosphere it's done well and it's the spot guests love most.

Food and bars — the resort's main restaurant is Garden Cafe, serving international all-day dining including a breakfast buffet · many reviews praise the breakfast for its variety and the atmosphere of eating in the garden, with Thai, Asian and Western dishes plus live counters at times · the other standout is Benihana, a Japanese teppanyaki restaurant where the chef cooks fresh in front of you, good for a special dinner or celebrating an occasion · there's also a poolside bar and a lobby lounge for an evening drink · to be straight about it, some reviews knock certain meals as fairly pricey for the portion, and the freshness of some buffet ingredients as inconsistent · but the strength of the location helps a lot, because a short walk gets you into Royal Garden Plaza with its range of restaurants, and the Central Pattaya area is full of seafood spots, street food and cafes — so many people choose to have breakfast at the resort and head out for other meals, which is part of the charm of staying in this area.

Service — service is another area that gets consistent praise in real reviews · several staff are named and thanked personally, because they're attentive, smiling and good at solving problems on the spot, especially the teams at the pool and at breakfast · check-in and check-out are mostly smooth, and the concierge team is good at calling cars, booking tours, or recommending places to go · as a brand of Minor Hotels, Avani holds a consistent standard of service to a degree · but to be straight about it, some voices in the reviews say that the team's responsiveness isn't equally consistent at all times, especially when the resort is full or has tour groups staying · overall it's still considered good and a strength of the place, and one of the reasons many guests come back to stay again.

Voices from real reviews (the good and the bad) — gathered from Trip.com, Booking.com, TripAdvisor and review sites like Oyster, the picture that emerges is fairly consistent · on the praise side: the Central Pattaya location next to a mall and a walk to the beach and Walking Street, the shady green garden that makes you feel calm in the middle of a busy town, the pool with a slide that kids love, the varied breakfast eaten in the garden, the spacious rooms with a balcony in every one, and the friendly, attentive staff · on the watch-out side: the thing mentioned most is noise — the Central Pattaya area is lively all night, with bars and music, and rooms facing the road at the front or on lower floors will pick up sound from outside; some reviews recount hearing loud music until late, but rooms on the garden side inside are much quieter · next is the building and certain decor that's starting to age, some meals being pricey for the portion, and inconsistent cleanliness in some rooms · these gripes are things you can manage by choosing a garden-side room and setting the right expectations, rather than being a big problem that stops people coming back, which is reflected in review scores that stay consistently high.

"Brought the kids to stay and they were hooked on the pool slide, wouldn't get out all day · the staff are lovely and look after you well · the only downside was the first night, when we got a front-facing room and could hear music from the bar until late; once we moved to a room on the garden side it was much quieter. Next time I'll ask for the garden side from the start."

Price comparison and value — the starting price for a Deluxe room is around ฿4,000/night at regular rates, climbing to about ฿6,000–7,000+ in high season or over long weekends · bigger rooms like the Garden View Corner Suite and Terrace Junior Suite sit from about ฿5,500 up into the low ten-thousands depending on size and timing · compared with other 5-star hotels in Central Pattaya, such as Hilton Pattaya, which sells sea views from a high-rise at a similar price, AVANI gives a completely different feel — trading high-floor sea views for a low-rise garden atmosphere that suits families and people who want to unwind · among garden resorts in the city with a pool slide and a walk to the beach, this price is good value and you won't easily find a competitor in the same location, especially if you value having a garden, a kids' pool and quiet over how new the building is · if you plan to use Central Pattaya as a base for sightseeing, shopping and hitting the beach, the money spent on this location and garden atmosphere pays off well.

What to know before you book — there are several things that help make the stay smoother · one, if you're a light sleeper or sensitive to noise, specify when booking that you want a room on the garden side inside that doesn't face the beach road, because the Central Pattaya area has bars and music until late · two, if you bring kids, the pool slide and kids' pool are the main draw, so allow time for them to swim to their hearts' content and check the pool opening hours · three, the building has been open a long time and was renovated in 2016, so if you want the best-condition room, ask for a recently refurbished one when you book · four, Pattaya's high season (November–February) and long weekends get busy and prices climb fast, so book ahead and compare prices across platforms · five, choose free cancellation if your plans aren't firm, because prices often change with the timing · six, make the most of the location by walking into Royal Garden Plaza and hitting the beach on a fine day.

Summary — from all the real reviews, AVANI Pattaya Resort is the resort best suited to families and couples who want a green garden atmosphere and a pool slide, but still want a city-centre location within walking distance of the mall, the beach and Walking Street · the shady garden in the city, the pool that kids love, the spacious rooms with a balcony in every one, and the friendly Avani-brand service make it good value, hard to match for a competitor in the same location · if you're after full-on sea views from a high-rise, or you want flawless, brand-new rooms in every corner, this may not be the answer, and you should consider a beachfront high-rise hotel like Hilton Pattaya or a newer resort over on the Jomtien side instead · but for a family trip or a couples' getaway wanting a garden oasis in central Pattaya, with the convenience of walking to everything — AVANI Pattaya is an option that meets that need almost perfectly, and it's the reason so many guests come back to stay year after year.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — AVANI Pattaya Resort

faq.q: Where is AVANI Pattaya Resort · what can you walk to?
faq.a: The resort is on the beach road in Central Pattaya, right next to Royal Garden Plaza shopping centre · walk across the road to Pattaya Beach, and it's only about an 8–9 minute walk from Walking Street · in the same mall you'll find Ripley's and the Louis Tussaud's wax museum · Terminal 21 or Central Pattaya is about 5–10 min by car, and U-Tapao Airport is about 45 min away.

faq.q: Does AVANI Pattaya have a pool and slide · is it good for kids?
faq.a: Yes — there's a garden pool with a slide, swim-up bar and a separate kids' pool, surrounded by large shady trees · it's the main draw that families with young children love most, with kids playing on the slide all day · it's a great fit for families.

faq.q: What's the starting price at AVANI Pattaya Resort · what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start at about ฿4,000/night for a Deluxe room of around 38 sqm at regular rates · there's a Garden View Corner Suite at 45 sqm and a Terrace Junior Suite at 52 sqm, plus rooms for families · every room has a private balcony · high-season prices (Nov–Feb) climb fast, so compare several platforms before booking.

It's a great fit for families with young children and couples who want a green garden atmosphere but still want a city-centre location, within walking distance of the mall, the beach and Walking Street · it has a pool slide and a shady garden at an accessible price · if you're after full-on sea views from a high-rise, Hilton Pattaya or a beachfront high-rise hotel may suit you better.

faq.q: What's the noise like at AVANI Pattaya · which room should I ask for?
faq.a: Many reviews agree that the Central Pattaya area is lively with bar and music noise until late, especially rooms facing the beach road or on lower floors · but rooms on the garden side inside are much quieter · if you're a light sleeper, ask for a garden-side room when you book or at check-in.

faq.q: What restaurants does AVANI Pattaya have?
faq.a: The main one is Garden Cafe, serving international all-day dining and a breakfast buffet eaten in the garden · there's a Japanese restaurant, Benihana, in teppanyaki style where the chef cooks fresh in front of you, good for a special dinner · plus a poolside bar and a lobby lounge · outside the resort you can walk straight into Royal Garden Plaza with its range of restaurants.
